name: SecureContent AI — Synthetic Benchmark
note: All content is synthetic. No real PII or credentials. Ground-truth labels are derived from the generator — measure against scanContent().
methodology: For each synthetic document: 1) run scanContent(), 2) compare findings vs labeled spans, 3) compute precision/recall per category, 4) sanitize with the declared profile, 5) run output DLP on sanitized text and check leakage=0, 6) record risk_before/after.
samples_reference: See src/lib/security/samples.ts and datasets/*/*.txt — these 5 canonical samples are the attack-driven demo. Extend with your own synthetic docs for measured benchmarking.
